notes.title: Early Access Now Available!
notes.notes:
Dear players, after a long time of optimization, the Early Access of Fated Land is finally online!
Do you remember the continent torn by war and destiny? Now, please join the protagonist Eric in gripping his sword and staff, and rewrite the destiny of this land together with his allies!

[h3]Three Reasons to Start Now<<<<<<<<<[/h3]
[b]A perfect symphony of tactics and strategy![/b]
Demonstrate the operation of a true master tactician!
In the battlefield, every rock is a shield, and every high ground is an arrow tower! Archers seize the high ground, warriors blockade the canyon... When the strategy is deployed, simply click to auto-battle and defeat the enemy with sophisticated strategy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/88814c1f3551a8595767481f8a80802d8d36d860.png[/img]
[b]Randomized Teammates[/b]
Each time you recruit, you may encounter teammates with different attributes and skills! Randomly generated character talents, with hundreds of equipment phrases and skill combinations, to create a unique squad!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/ce64a72c512ad72e707b84c16ccc867210e6fdb8.png[/img]
[b]Rebuild civilization in the ruins![/b]
Gather resources to rebuild the Fated Land by traveling between the wreckage of the Elven Tree and the scorched earth of human cities and states! Every brick and mortar holds a secret... After all, there's only one place on the continent where elves and rangers can soak in hot springs and human blacksmiths can forge artifacts at the same time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/e59b22be291824f3a30b7ed3b2b622addab569fc.png[/img]

[h3]Multiple storylines at your disposal <<<<<<<<<[/h3]
From the protagonist Eric's vengeance for his loved ones, to the grief of the elf priest Clara Lessing.
Every time you switch characters, you open up a different character's script. You will search for the truth in different perspectives and unravel the shadows that shroud the continent...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/c9d10b4ea2facc843cb7f65f614952e9301a3ab5.png[/img]

[h3]WARNING: The following may result in 48 hours of sleepless play [/h3]
√ Deepseek model access to put yourself in the shoes of the storyline (ps: your dialog may affect how things go ......)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/fd7d2b99fb72b236df901ef10b4227245f5a0154.png[/img]
√ Multiple random battlefield events incorporating roguelike. You can also customize the storyline and upload it for sharing

√ A map with freely editable terrain

√ Explorable ruins that change with the seasons (surprise when the lake freezes in winter!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/7c58afb68edffbbc10b0ef51a42b76ea84f9f5d8.png[/img]
√ Exclusive human x elf team combos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/f7494af7c74137b72f9060643ff6b88c5a9af1a4.png[/img]
√ Upgrading techniques hidden in the cooking system (try adding gunpowder to elf wine?)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/2df6ea96ed54b092f9b5cd8c8d9ffc277473eaf6.png[/img]

notes.title: 【Next Fest】 An Atypical RPG Game!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm Mo.

In the last year, I started to develop a turn-based RPG, [b][i]Fated Land[/i][/b], and I've added everything that other traditional RPGs have:
[h3]*Classic wargame RPG character development, team building, skill development, item management, and equipment creation.

*Exploration of the open world - item gathering, territory building[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/67f819abd81481e7eec78ef9a6f968a7dc2e23ca.png[/img]

Early this year I gave the Demo to a few players and some publishers, their feedback is largely now who still play the game away from the grid ah....

So, I made into a turn-based and automatic battle fusion, so that we can experience the traditional JRPG, but also can personally complete the pre-deployment of a key after the automatic battle, to experience the ‘Auto Chess’ of the The game

At the same time, in order to make difference, I also did these: 
[h3]*Roguelike generates teammates' characters (different skills, attributes, talents...).

*With the unlocking of the storyline, you can experience the storyline of characters from different camps.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/8a1eb79d79f47baa9eba404c89c9dd6b99668350.png[/img]

Welcome to experience this atypical RPG!
If you have any suggestions or comments, please let me know at [url=https://discord.com/invite/bvC8qN4AWg]DISCORD[/url].
EA is coming soon, please [b]WISHLIST[/b] and support us, thank you very much!

notes.title: Demo Available! JRPG + Territory Building
notes.notes:
It's been a long time coming folks! The Demo of the tactical self-propelled RPG [b][i]Fated Land[/i][/b] is ready to meet you all!

I was so excited that I forgot to introduce myself to you all. I'm Mo, the pioneer of this land!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/c223505b9173fea499715043a0618b2e765d7439.png[/img]

What I'm doing now with Fated Land is  a blend of everything I find fun --

*A fusion of Turn-Based and Auto-Battle
*Classic RPG development, team compilation, skill development, item management, equipment creation
*Roguelike to generate teammate characters (different skills, attributes, talents...)
*Explore the open world - gathering materials, territory building.
*Experience different camps' character storylines...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/67f819abd81481e7eec78ef9a6f968a7dc2e23ca.png[/img]

In [b][i]Fated Land[/i][/b], in addition to feeling the joy of original JRPG and Battle Chess, you'll also be sure to experience the innovative elements I've hardworking.

[h2]Tactical self-propelled RPG[/h2]
The battle is semi-turn-based, and you need to formulate a battle plan based on the battle environment and the characteristics of the enemy - assembling appropriate props and weapons for your teammates to target the enemy's weaknesses; deploying your teammates of various professions according to the course of the battle, and adjusting flexibly; and taking advantage of terrains such as heights and obstacles to pull the enemy to the limit.
Is everything set up properly? Try to free your hands and fight automatically!

[h2]Customise your character to create a unique squad[/h2]
Classic RPG character development, skill development, equipment creation
Roguelike generated under the teammates characters, they all have randomly generated skills, attributes and talents; you need to choose the appropriate cultivation route according to the existing material and team member's talent; Choose the right partner to the team, to form a unique combat squad to complete this fated journey.

[h2]Explore the open world[/h2]
Lead your squad through an open world filled with puzzles and hidden objects; collect resources to build and upgrade your territory.

[h2]Face the fate[/h2]
There's a special bond between humans and elves.... The sudden resurgence of the xenomorphs has caused an existential crisis for them, and they are forced to put aside their hatred for the time being and join forces in the fight

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/8a1eb79d79f47baa9eba404c89c9dd6b99668350.png[/img]

Currently, I'm also working non-stop to continue creating new contents for both the EARLY ACCESS and the FULL RELEASE.
However, as an individual developer is very limited, So I invite you to come to experience the DEMO and join our [url=https://discord.gg/bvC8qN4AWg]DISCORD[/url].

Your suggestions and feedback are the direction of the update!
Please also WISHLIST to support me, the EARLY ACCESS will be with you soon!

notes.title: Atypical JRPG with Turn-Based & Auto-Combat & Rougelike Teammates
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Fated Land, I'm Mo, the developer of the game.

 [i][b]Fated Land[/b][/i] is a [b]Tactical Semi-Turn-Based[/b] RPG in which you can control each character to perform clever tactics, or complete battles in self-propelled mode after carefully arranging your stations and skill choices.

On your journey, you will meet the characters with different skills, attributes and talents. Make up a team and choose the right partners to complete the journey!

As the storyline progresses and characters are unlocked, you can also take other races as the main characters and unfold a different storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/d0acea54a0fdff94a83784c752427817bebb9385.png[/img]

*Classic RPG with Tactical Semi-Turn-Based，character development, skill cultivation, equipment creation and so on.
The teammate characters generated under the Roguelike, they all have randomly generated skills, attributes and talents; You need to choose the suitable cultivation route based on the available materials and the talents of the teammates; Choose the suitable partners to the team compilation, and set up a uniquely personalised battle squad to complete this Fated Journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/4167352062ef8fe0116a0734180d02395707b948.png[/img]

*You will need to apply appropriate strategies and combat techniques to complete each battle. Taking into account factors such as different terrain, resources and enemy types!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/b638aaf7e7fd4af0f80ee7c5abcb929e653bca6d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/dd104975873c102c3dcd66ea3c3e8ab8b650113c.png[/img]

* Gather various resources in the world and build your own territories and fortresses, which will make you to expand your blueprint in the Fated Land

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/6281a58c26ffa56bcbdbd620929a09a7c4845f47.png[/img]

[b][A post-apocalyptic tale of the Middle Ages][/b]

The Fated Land takes place in a war-torn continent. Humans and elves are at war... But a new threat, the Xenomorphs, has risen to destroy the entire continent, reducing cities to rubble and leaving the people to survive in the aftermath of the apocalypse. You will take on the role, a young adventurer searching for hope in the land of destiny.

As the story progresses, you will be able to take on different roles and experience the story from the perspective of an elf or even a demon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/29923836ac5b175b138ff5f3ad10f4e766bb78db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186843/0d8c9222aaea3a140f4983793839e94fc441a468.png[/img]

As a developer, I'm honoured to have met up with you in this Fated Land.

You can[b] play the Demo in the Steam Next Fest on 14-21 October[/b]. Please [b]WISHLIST US[/b] and feel free to give us suggestions!
Welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/bvC8qN4AWgto give us feedback ]DISCORD[/url]
